categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Jutze Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent equipment and components. Its main business segments include machine vision equipment, control cable assemblies, and control units and devices. These products serve key industries such as electronic information manufacturing, industrial control, financial electronics, new energy, and automotive sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced machine vision technologies integrating optics, electronics, artificial intelligence, and image processing algorithms, including 2D/3D AOI, 3D X-ray inspection (AXI), and high-precision dispensing machines. It employs proprietary software algorithms, high-precision optical imaging systems, multi-angle lighting, and servo-driven positioning systems. Production follows a make-to-order model with a focus on quality, innovation, and flexible manufacturing supported by RPA and supply chain management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global and domestic enterprises such as Apple, Huawei, Xiaomi, BYD, BOE, and Hikvision, as well as major financial equipment manufacturers like NCR Group and Diebold Group, and semiconductor equipment manufacturers like Ultra Clean Group. The company’s products are widely applied in electronics manufacturing, semiconductor packaging and testing, automotive electronics, and other industrial automation fields.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for over 70% of revenue, and maintains a growing overseas presence. It has established subsidiaries and branches in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Czech Republic, Vietnam, and Mexico, with an overseas manufacturing base in Penang, Malaysia, to support global supply chain localization and regional service hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Jutze Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying intelligent inspection equipment and control components that serve as critical parts for downstream manufacturers in electronics, semiconductor, automotive, and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained R&D investment in machine vision, AI algorithm integration, and new product development such as semiconductor AOI, 3D X-ray inspection, and multi-angle robotic inspection systems. It aims to expand product applications, enhance detection accuracy and efficiency, and accelerate international market penetration while fostering a high-quality, sustainable growth trajectory.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and agency distribution of machine vision equipment, control cable assemblies, and control units. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with sales recognized upon transfer of control, typically after product delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Jutze Technology is positioned as a leading mid-to-high-end supplier in the machine vision and control components industry in China, successfully breaking foreign monopolies in 3D machine vision equipment. It competes with global brands and has established a strong domestic brand reputation supported by advanced technology and quality. Major competitors include international machine vision and semiconductor equipment manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 662 million, an 18% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 66 million, though net profit declined by nearly 20%. The company maintains total assets of around RMB 1.85 billion and equity of RMB 1.62 billion. R&D expenses accounted for over 10% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company is experiencing steady growth with expanding overseas operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, intelligent, and automated inspection solutions with proprietary core technologies in optics, AI-driven image processing, and integrated hardware-software systems. Its products offer superior detection speed, accuracy, and reliability, enabling customers to improve production efficiency and quality control. The company’s ability to provide customized, comprehensive inspection solutions and its successful import substitution in key sectors differentiate it competitively.
